name: roy-local
description: Locally developed Claude Code plugins, installed from this working tree so the skill can be edited and used in the same session

plugins.name: comment-review
plugins.description: Professional editorial practice for a codebase's prose: four read-only reviewers ask whether each comment is still true of the code it sits on, and where prose and code disagree the disagreement is often about the design. Where the code is right the comment is corrected; where it is not, a code concern is filed rather than the prose bent to fit. The author approves every replacement, and WRITE proves the executable code byte-identical.
